items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And ask him what his next instrument was after Aldo.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And ask him what his next instrument was after Aldo.
Well, the next thing you played was that mellophone, huh? Yeah. The next instrument you played after the alto was the mellophone? Mm-hmm. That's all you played? Mellophone.
